verdict.rationale: Pinecone is a retrieval platform that also ships Assistant and no-code knowledge apps, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question, but the evidence shows no such capability. Index backups and API versioning are adjacent features: they cover data protection and API stability, not versioning, review, or rollback of user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
